notes: Every value is an end-of-month stock as CBI publishes it, in thousand billion rials (هزار میلیارد ریال).
Months from Tir 1397 come from CBI's monthly Selected Economic Indicators workbooks; earlier periods are quarter-ends from CBI's time-series database.
CBI states no release date: published_at is the workbook's own saved time, a lower bound, and available_at is when this system could first have read it.
